# Income test

You must meet an income test to get a Commonwealth Seniors Health Card.

## on this page

- [Income limits for the Commonwealth Seniors Health Card](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/income-test-for-commonwealth-seniors-health-card?context=21966#a1)
- [Account-based income streams](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/income-test-for-commonwealth-seniors-health-card?context=21966#a2)

We review this test on 20 September each year in line with the Consumer Price Index.

The income test looks at both:

- your [adjusted taxable income](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/what-adjusted-taxable-income?context=21966), and your partner’s, if applicable
- any [deemed](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/deeming?context=21966) income from any of your account-based income streams.

## Income limits for the Commonwealth Seniors Health Card

To meet the income test, your annual gross taxable income must be less than:

- $105,048.00 a year if you’re single
- $168,076.00 a year for couples
- $210,096.00 a year for couples separated by illness, respite care or prison.

Add $639.60 to these amounts for each child in your care.

There’s no assets test.

## Account-based income streams

We look at your account-based income streams as part of the income test. Account based income streams include account-based pensions and account-based annuities.

The balance of an account-based income stream is subject to [deeming](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/deeming?context=21966). Deeming assumes that financial investments are earning a certain rate of income.

Deeming rules only apply if any of the following happens:

- you bought or changed it on or after 1 January 2015
- you own it and we granted your Commonwealth Seniors Health Card after 31 December 2014
- your partner owns it and they’re 60 or older.

Find out about [account-based income streams](http://guides.dss.gov.au/guide-social-security-law/3/9/3/31) on the Department of Social Services website.

[Deeming\\
\\
Deeming rules are used to work out income from your financial assets. We add this to your other income and apply the income test to determine your payment rate.](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/deeming?context=21966)
